City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meeting
AGENDA
la puente City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meeting
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
MAY 28, 2013
07:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
PRESENTATION TO COUNCIL MEMBER DAN HOLLOWAY FROM CHIEF STONE
CERTIFICATES OF RECOGNITION TO EDUCATION SCHOLARSHIP AWARDEES
CERTIFICATES OF APPRECIATION TO SPRING EGG HUNT VOLUNTEERS
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council and Successor Agency on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE SPECIAL MEETING OF MAY 8, 2013 AND THE REGULAR MEETING OF MAY 14, 2013
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Special Meeting of May 8, 2013 and the Regular meeting of May 14, 2013.
A-1 05-08-2013 CC Minutes
A-1 05-14-2013 CC-SA Minutes
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL - None.
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION ON OPTIONS FOR CONTINUING THE STARS AFTER SCHOOL PROGRAM AT HURLEY ELEMENTARY
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council provide direction to staff regarding options for continuing the STARS After School Program at the Hurley Elementary School Site.
C-1 Hurley After School Program
D.
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1341 FISCAL YEAR 2012-2013
The City Council adopted the Resolution No. 13-5076 approving Warrant Register No. 1341.
D-1 CC Warrant Register # 1341
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF FIREWORKS SALES PERMITS FOR VETERANS GROUPS FOR THE 2013 INDEPENDENCE DAY SEASON
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the issuance of permits to sell Safe and Sane Fireworks by Veterans of Foreign Wars Post 1944 pursuant to all applicable code requirements.
D-2 Consideration of Fireworks Sales_2013
D-2 2013 - Letter to City Council Requesting Fireworks Stands Approval - La Puente
D-3
ACCEPTANCE OF NOTICE OF COMPLETION FOR THE TRAFFIC SIGNAL MODIFICATION AND INSTALLATION AT VARIOUS LOCATIONS - PROJECT NO. HSIPL-5331(10) AND PROJECT NO. HSIPL-5331(017)
The City Council: 1) Accepted the project as complete and 2) Authorized the City Clerk to execute the Notice of Completion.
D-3 Notice of Completion - Staff Report - HSIP Traffic Signals
D-3 Notice of Completion HSIP Attach A
D-4
ACCEPTANCE OF NOTICE OF COMPLETION FOR VALLEY BOULEVARD IMPROVEMENT PROJECT-PHASE II (CDBG PROJECT NO. 601439-11)
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council: 1) Accept the project as complete and 2) Authorize the City Clerk to execute the Notice of Completion.
D-4 AcceptValleyBlvdPhase II - Staff Report
D-4 Attach A Notice of Completion Valley Blvd Phase II
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
AUTHORIZATION TO SOLICIT BIDS FOR LOCAL STREET IMPROVEMENTS ON CLINTWOOD AVENUE AND CABANA AVENUE AND CONCRETE REPAIRS AT VARIOUS LOCATIONS IN THE CITY
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council: 1) Approve the plans and specifications for the Construction of Local Street Improvements and Concrete Repairs at various locations in the City; and (2) Authorize Staff to solicit for bids.
E-1 CC AuthSolicitBidFY12-13LocalStreetsRev1 2
E-2
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT SATURATION PATROLS AND COMMUNITY POLICING ISSUES (Council Member Argudo)
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide staff direction.
E-3
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING MAINTENANCE OF SNACK BAR BUILDING AT LA PUENTE PARK (Mayor Klinakis)
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide staff direction.
ADHOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
AB 1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF - None.
ADJOURNMENT
05-28-13 CC-SA Minutes Reg - Signed
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements.
Dated this
___________________________________
Pat Jacquez-Nares, CMC, City Clerk

City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meeting
MINUTES
LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY REGULAR MEETING
REGULAR MEETING OF
May 28, 2013
A Regular Meeting of the City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meeting of the City of La Puente was held in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 15900 East Main Street, La Puente, California, on May 28, 2013, at 07:00 p.m.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
PRESENTATION TO COUNCIL MEMBER DAN HOLLOWAY FROM CHIEF STONE
CERTIFICATES OF RECOGNITION TO EDUCATION SCHOLARSHIP AWARDEES
CERTIFICATES OF APPRECIATION TO SPRING EGG HUNT VOLUNTEERS
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE SPECIAL MEETING OF MAY 8, 2013 AND THE REGULAR MEETING OF MAY 14, 2013
A-1 05-08-2013 CC Minutes
A-1 05-14-2013 CC-SA Minutes
Vince House moved to waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Special Meeting of May 8, 2013 and the Regular meeting of May 14, 2013.; seconded by David Argudo.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Charlie Klinakis, Vince House, David Argudo, Dan Holloway, and Violeta Lewis. NOES: None.
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL - None.
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION ON OPTIONS FOR CONTINUING THE STARS AFTER SCHOOL PROGRAM AT HURLEY ELEMENTARY
C-1 Hurley After School Program
Vince House moved to Discontinue at end of this fiscal year the STARS After School Program at the Hurley Elementary School Site.; seconded by Dan Holloway.
The motion carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Charlie Klinakis, Vince House, Dan Holloway, and Violeta Lewis. NOES: David Argudo.
D.
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
Action Taken : All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
Vince House moved to Consent Calendar Items D-1 and D-3.; seconded by David Argudo.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Charlie Klinakis, Vince House, David Argudo, Dan Holloway, and Violeta Lewis. NOES: None.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1341 FISCAL YEAR 2012-2013
D-1 CC Warrant Register # 1341
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF FIREWORKS SALES PERMITS FOR VETERANS GROUPS FOR THE 2013 INDEPENDENCE DAY SEASON
D-2 Consideration of Fireworks Sales_2013
D-2 2013 - Letter to City Council Requesting Fireworks Stands Approval - La Puente
Dan Holloway moved to the issuance of permits to sell Safe and Sane Fireworks by Veterans of Foreign Wars Post 1944 pursuant to all applicable code requirements and bring back the entire subject of fireworks sales for Independence Day to the City Council for review and any modifications that need to be made.; seconded by Vince House.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Charlie Klinakis, Vince House, David Argudo, Dan Holloway, and Violeta Lewis. NOES: None.
D-3
ACCEPTANCE OF NOTICE OF COMPLETION FOR THE TRAFFIC SIGNAL MODIFICATION AND INSTALLATION AT VARIOUS LOCATIONS - PROJECT NO. HSIPL-5331(10) AND PROJECT NO. HSIPL-5331(017)
D-3 Notice of Completion - Staff Report - HSIP Traffic Signals
D-3 Notice of Completion HSIP Attach A
D-4
ACCEPTANCE OF NOTICE OF COMPLETION FOR VALLEY BOULEVARD IMPROVEMENT PROJECT-PHASE II (CDBG PROJECT NO. 601439-11)
D-4 AcceptValleyBlvdPhase II - Staff Report
D-4 Attach A Notice of Completion Valley Blvd Phase II
David Argudo moved to 1) Accept the project as complete and 2) Authorize the City Clerk to execute the Notice of Completion.; seconded by Vince House.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Charlie Klinakis, Vince House, David Argudo, Dan Holloway, and Violeta Lewis. NOES: None.
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
AUTHORIZATION TO SOLICIT BIDS FOR LOCAL STREET IMPROVEMENTS ON CLINTWOOD AVENUE AND CABANA AVENUE AND CONCRETE REPAIRS AT VARIOUS LOCATIONS IN THE CITY
E-1 CC AuthSolicitBidFY12-13LocalStreetsRev1 2
Vince House moved to 1) Approve the plans and specifications for the Construction of Local Street Improvements and Concrete Repairs at various locations in the City; and (2) Authorize Staff to solicit for bids.; seconded by Dan Holloway.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Charlie Klinakis, Vince House, David Argudo, Dan Holloway, and Violeta Lewis. NOES: None.
E-2
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT SATURATION PATROLS AND COMMUNITY POLICING ISSUES (Council Member Argudo)
David Argudo moved to develop a process with staff and Police Chief Lt. Cacheiro to develop an plan for accessibility of these funds and bring back the process at the June 4, 2013 city council meeting and then at that time address additional funding after the public input.; seconded by -1.
E-3
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING MAINTENANCE OF SNACK BAR BUILDING AT LA PUENTE PARK (Mayor Klinakis)
Vince House moved to use money for the reserve funds to fix the snack bar roof.; seconded by Dan Holloway.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Charlie Klinakis, Vince House, David Argudo, Dan Holloway, and Violeta Lewis. NOES: None.
ADHOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
AB 1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF - None.
ADJOURNMENT
05-28-13 CC-SA Minutes Reg - Signed
Approved this
